verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents the full instance lifecycle through its CLI, SDK and REST API, and a runtime probe confirmed the CLI exposes search offers, create instance and destroy instance. The hello-world guide walks through searching, renting, waiting for boot, connecting, copying data and cleaning up. A first-party agent skill lets AI assistants find, rent, launch and tear down instances, scoped API keys support unattended automation, and workloads can be run via an entrypoint override or remote SSH commands. Missing for 10: monitoring beyond instance status (metrics, logs) is thinly documented, there is no evidence of an official MCP server (only an agent skill), the hands-on probe did not run an authenticated create-run-destroy cycle, and account signup and initial credit top-up are shown only in the console.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can provision a GPU, monitor it, run a workload, and tear it down end to end through documented APIs, CLI, or MCP without a human in the console

citations.quote: The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect to it, copy data, and clean up
A **skill** or **plugin** lets an agent operate your **account** — find, rent, launch, and tear down instances.
Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
`vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
The docker image entrypoint is the main run process, which you can override in the GUI or CLI (--entrypoint).
